testcase.name: Scenario: Cycle all ribbon display modes in one part session: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-display-source/features/application/ribbon-display/ribbon-display.feature:209:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cycle all ribbon display modes in one part session ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon display control is configured to cycle through all modes ✔ And the View ribbon tab displays its full groups of commands ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control ✔ Then the View groups are shown as compact buttons ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control again ✔ Then the View group titles appear in a narrow strip ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control again ✔ Then the tabs remain visible without a permanent group strip ✔ When the user selects the View tab ✔ Then its commands appear in a temporary panel ✔ When the user activates the ribbon display control again ✔ And the user clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ Then the full View command groups remain visible ✔ And the same part remains active
